filters.label: Dashboard filters
filters.periodNote: The trend period applies only to period charts; "Current condition" widgets always show the situation now.
filters.timezoneNote: Dates and months follow the company time zone ({{timezone}}).

limitations.tiresWithoutRuleProfile: {{count}} installed tires have no applicable active rule profile (D_pull) and could not be assessed.
limitations.tiresWithoutTreadReading: {{count}} installed tires have no tread depth reading and could not be assessed.

states.loadFailed: This widget could not be loaded.
states.noWidgets: No dashboard widgets are available for your permissions and active modules.

fl01.empty: No vehicles in your scope yet.
fl01.help: Vehicles by their current status, in your branch scope. Disposed vehicles are not part of the fleet. Click a segment for the vehicle list.
fl01.title: Fleet Status

fl02.empty: No vehicles in your scope yet.
fl02.help: Current vehicle status per branch (the branch the vehicle belongs to now). Click a bar for that branch's vehicles.
fl02.title: Fleet by Branch

fl03.help: Breakdowns not yet resolved. Running time = now − downtime start (or report time when no downtime start was recorded). This is a running duration, not MTTR.
fl03.title: Active Breakdowns

fl06.empty: No document deadlines in the next 90 days.
fl06.help: The latest document per vehicle and type (by issue date) is assessed; OTHER documents one by one. Expiry dates and extension deadlines are counted separately, up to 90 days ahead.
fl06.title: Vehicle Document Deadlines

fn05.help: On hand × moving-average unit cost, per warehouse, now. No history is kept, so no trend is shown.
fn05.title: Inventory Value

mt01.help: Open maintenance schedules by the status the system computes from due date and odometer.
mt01.title: Maintenance Schedule Status

mt02.help: Schedules with status Overdue, most overdue first: days past the due date, then km past the due odometer (from the vehicle's current odometer).
mt02.title: Overdue Maintenance

mt03.help: Requests waiting for a decision or a Work Order (Draft, Submitted, Under Review, Approved).
mt03.title: Open Maintenance Requests

pr01.help: Open Purchase Requests and Purchase Orders by stage, in your warehouse scope. Each section appears only with its view permission.
pr01.title: Procurement Pipeline

pr02.help: Issued or partially received Purchase Orders past their expected delivery date.
pr02.title: Late Purchase Orders

tr01.help: Where the tires are now (scrapped, sold and lost tires are not counted). Visibility follows the tire's vehicle, warehouse or last branch.
tr01.title: Tire Status

tr02.help: Installed tires whose latest tread reading is at or below D_pull of the applicable active rule profile, plus used-tire inspections awaiting approval. Free-text notes are not used.
tr02.title: Tires Due Replacement

tr03.help: Retread and repair cycles sent to a vendor and not yet received, oldest first.
tr03.title: Tires at Vendor

wh01.empty: No stock in your warehouses yet.
wh01.help: Stock rows (product × warehouse) by availability (on hand − reserved): out of stock (≤ 0), below reorder point, normal.
wh01.title: Stock Health

wh02.help: Out-of-stock and below-reorder-point items. Items an open Work Order still needs from that warehouse come first.
wh02.showNeeded: Show only items needed by Work Orders
wh02.title: Stockout & Below Reorder Point

wh03.help: Open transfers, transfers in transit (flagged after the threshold) and transfers received recently with a discrepancy (received less than sent, damaged or lost).
wh03.title: Stock Transfers

ws01.help: Open Work Orders by status, in the workshops you can access (the same rule as the Work Order list). Drafts are shown separately.
ws01.title: Work Order Backlog

ws02.help: Open Work Orders by age since creation, in company-local days. Green ≤ 7 days, amber 8–14, red > 14. Time in the current status is not measured.
ws02.legend: Green: up to 7 days · Amber: 8–14 days · Red: more than 14 days
ws02.title: Open Work Order Aging

ws05.help: Current status of the workshop bays (inactive bays are left out).
ws05.title: Workspace Occupancy

ws06.empty: No Work Orders waiting for parts.
ws06.help: Work Orders in Waiting for Part, with their part requests not yet issued. Waiting time is counted from the oldest pending part request.
ws06.title: Work Orders Waiting for Parts
